title: Apps Analyst-Clinical
description:
CBORD Analyst, shall assist Northwell with the following:
• Work under the direction of the Manager/team lead to analyze requirements for application modifications, reports and implementation requests.
• Develop and implement test plans for application modifications and upgrades.
• Maintain documentation based on standard operating procedures in support of the CBORD Application.
• Troubleshoot problems with interfaces that arise with interface testing
• Documenting all configuration activities and system specifications
• Conduct unit testing, functional testing, and assist in integrated testing.
• Identify, coordinate, and communicate issues, requirements and status related to application functionality with other team members and software vendors.
• Maintain updates to project tracker, participate in meetings, and understand impacts new project present
• Understand ADT workflows
• Understand Clinical workflows and patient experience for the Health System
• Ability to review and provide feedback on release notes/readme files
• Ability to provide feedback and help make decisions on priority and timelines/deadlines
• Work with peers to understand the magnitude and impact of issues that arise within the applications
• Understand HL7 interface messages types
• Understand how EPI integration works and merges
• Understanding of interface standards for CBORD and EPIC applications, and ability to suggest new standards when appropriate.
• In-Depth knowledge of interfaces in respective area
• Ability to design new interfaces and modify existing interfaces
• Lead mapping calls for respective area

Academic and Professional Qualifications:

• BA or BS degree in Computer Science, Healthcare or related field of study required
• Understanding HL7 interface standards and specifications
• Understanding of hospital and ancillary department workflows
• Experience working in a clinical capacity preferred
• Experience working with CBORD NSS – Nutritional Service Suite preferred
• Solid foundation of Microsoft Office products


Experience:
• 3-5 years industry experience preferred
• 3-5 years experience in providing technical support and maintenance in assigned product preferred
• 3-5 years’ Experience working with Clinical EMR with HL7 interface experience preferred

What We Do/Project

The Media Coordinator/Specialist supports the Owned & Operated Media team in the planning and execution of promotional content across USN linear and digital platforms for the full WBD portfolio. This role is critical to the flawless execution of strategic media plans and requires a high level of precision, organization, and cross-functional collaboration.

We are seeking candidates with prior experience in strategic implementation of broadcast logs and digital placements. This is not a creative or product development role, but rather one focused on leveraging analytics to inform media planning (communication) and execution.

Job Responsibilities / Typical Day in the Role
• Serve as a primary point of contact for implementation across WBD USN O&O media inventory.
• Execute daily and weekly promotional priorities with a focus on accurate log scheduling and timely delivery.
• Set up campaigns in linear and digital scheduling systems, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.
• Traffic digital video and display creatives using platforms such as Google Ad Manager, Freewheel, and Campaign Manager, ensuring proper placement across inventory.
• Monitor campaign performance and conduct data analysis for both linear and digital media efforts.
• Assist in building custom audience targets using data sources such as Nielsen and 1st/3rd party analytics.
• Resolve discrepancy reports from the Broadcast Center regarding promos, including during off-hours as part of an on-call rotation.
• Collaborate with Marketing, Media Logistics, Digital Agencies, and Commercial Operations to ensure network strategies are followed and troubleshoot technical issues as needed.
• Produce ad hoc reports and support additional duties as assigned.

Must Have Skills / Requirements
1) Broadcast Log Scheduling & Media Operations Interest or Experience
a. This role is deeply rooted in the execution of promos across linear/digital platforms, which requires solid time management skills, prioritization, detail oriented.
2) Digital Trafficking & Platform Experience
a. Candidates manage placements across WBD’s digital platforms.
3) Data Analysis & Audience Targeting
a. The role involves monitoring campaign performance and building audience targets using proprietary programs.

Screening Must Haves:
1. Strong relationship with numbers
2. Interest in media
3. Fearlessness to ask questions

Nice to Have Skills / Preferred Requirements
1) Familiarity with building custom audiences.
2) Understanding how linear and digital media complement each other in a cross-platform promotional strategy.
3) Prior work in a TV network, or media agency environment, especially with promotional scheduling.

Soft Skills:
1) Highly motivated individual who takes initiative and has a positive demeanor.
2) Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in scheduling and trafficking tasks.
3) Proven ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
4) Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interface effectively across various departments and levels of the organization.
5) Comfortable working independently and collaboratively, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Technology Requirements:
1) Familiarity with media systems and platforms such as Google Ad Manager, Freewheel, and Nielsen tools. Also excellent working knowledge of Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint.

Education / Certifications
1) Must have completed a Bachelors Degree in Communications/Advertising or a related field.

Interview Process / Next Steps
1) 1st round with HM
2) 2nd round with HM and Lead
3) 3rd round with Senior Manager

Additional Notes
• Sourcing in New York – Park Ave S
• Hybrid; 3-days on-site per week. Will need to be on-site every working day while training.

title: Senior Counsel
description:
Short Term Contract
Hybrid until January 2026 and then onsite.


Overview and Responsibilities:

· In this role you will be responsible for drafting and negotiating agreements in all areas of domestic and international television development and production, including services agreements for producers, writers, directors and actors, rights acquisition agreements, co-production and other (co-)financing agreements, production services agreements, co-venture agreements, license agreements, overall agreements and other production-related agreements.

· In this role you will also act as the show attorney for certain television pilots and series, and in that capacity will handle day-to-day production legal matters and counsel productions and studio executives in connection with all aspects of television development, production and post-production, including the following:

o collaborating and advising on contractual issues, clearance issues involving copyright, trademark, defamation and rights of privacy, and publicity and promotional activities; and

o reviewing and analyzing contracts and providing risk assessments, including with respect to chain-of-title and derivative rights issues, and intellectual property matters.

· In this role you will also be responsible for providing as-needed transaction support for acquisitions, joint ventures and equity investments, and will be asked to help build out, improve on and simplify existing legal processes and mechanisms and departmental knowledge management.


Qualifications:

· Juris Doctor, admission to California state bar (registered in-house counsel in California will also be considered), and strong academic credentials.

· 6+ years of experience working at a studio, network or other entertainment company in scripted television production, and experience with guild issues.

· Knowledge of defamation, privacy, trademark and copyright law.

· Someone who excels at drafting and has excellent verbal and written communication, negotiation, interpersonal and analytical skills.

· Ability to effectively manage competing priorities in a time-sensitive environment.

· Good judgment, a collaborative spirit, and a willingness to handle Client matters and projects outside of usual area of practice.

· Ability to work and communicate well with producers, other production personnel, and additional departments, including Business Affairs negotiators and Casting, Production, Labor and Publicity executives.
